nom: The Ordinary Soothing & Barrier Support Serum for Sensitive Skin & Hydration

segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers report mixed results: some describe improved oiliness and no new breakouts, others report clogged pores, excess oil and a bad acne breakout.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers most often report relief of flakiness, plumping and restored moisture, though a few describe worsened dryness and stinging.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report the product works well as an occasional treatment rather than a daily step, with one noting pilling and peeling under makeup and a shiny, stiff finish.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are the most frequent group and mostly report calming of redness, stinging or hives being avoided, and successful barrier repair, but several describe breakouts, stinging or itching, especially at first use.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her 40s describes using it alongside stronger anti-aging actives to restrengthen her barrier, and another in her 30s-40s calls it a helpful part of her evolving routine, both without complaint.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using stronger actives (retinol, tretinoin) report this serum offsets the dryness and irritation those treatments cause and lets them keep using them; one long-term Ordinary user also credits her overall regimen for firmer, younger-looking skin.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe strong, sometimes instant relief of dryness, flakiness and dehydrated patches, with several calling it their best hydration treatment for winter or damaged-barrier skin; a minority report it dried their skin out further or stung on application.
concerns.redness: The majority of rosacea and redness-prone reviewers report significant, often fast reduction in redness and calming of flare-ups; one reviewer with rosacea reports it worsened her redness and did the opposite of what was claimed.
concerns.barrier: Many reviewers used it specifically to repair a damaged barrier from over-exfoliation, retinoids, or environmental damage and report it worked, some within hours or a single week; a few say it made barrier damage worse or caused stinging when sweating.
concerns.spots: Some acne-prone reviewers report old spots fading and fewer new ones forming, including one noting improved hyperpigmentation and evenness after one use.
concerns.blemishes: Many acne-prone reviewers report breakouts healing faster or clearing up entirely, sometimes within days; several other reviewers, including some with sensitive or oily skin, report new breakouts, small red bumps or a cystic pimple response instead.
concerns.oiliness: A couple of reviewers with oily or combination skin note the product reduced daytime oiliness or greasiness, while one reviewer with oily skin reports it triggered excess oil production and clogged pores.

aspects.libelle: Pilling and flaking under makeup or spf
Pink tint wipes or comes off on fabric

extraits.texte: I battle redness and sensitive skin and this product made it a lot worse. Terrible for rosacea in my case.

So I am 26 years old and have been theiugh the ringer with oily skin with dryness patches and sensitivety to acids. I actually used to have to test products on my wrist since i could accidentally chemical burn my face, since i had no skin barrier left from all the poor skin maintence in my teens. I wanted something to help with redness and naturally heal my skin instead of the chemicalized 1 stop shop products, that are expensive and end up not working for me. Over the last 6 months ive seen significant decrease in redness in my t zone. It was not over night but gradual in about 30 day increments for me to see a difference. I adore how rhis product makes my skin feel so much so that ive switched all my skin care (except face wash) to ordinary products.

extraits.titre: 20/10, Fav INSANE Hydrating TREATMENT (not daily serum)
extraits.texte: I've tried SEVERAL (25-30) hydrating serums within the past few years, a lot of them $80+ , yet this is my favorite one which I have been using for YEARS. However, I would not say this is a daily serum if you have overall oily or well-hydrated skin. If you have never tried this before, I would highly recommend using it only 2-3 times a week and slowly work your way up to see how much moisture you really need. OR even try just spot usage on the places that need the most moisture. I am 29 and have combination skin (oily t-zone + normal to dry skin everywhere else depending on the season), my skin is also very sensitive. When I first started using this, I used it every day and LOVED it bc it feels like your skin is literally chugged water that doesn't evaporate. However, I noticed that I started getting little bumps around my t-zone and around my nose. I realized after some time that this serum, for me at least, wasn't meant to be used as a daily/all-year/all over the face-use item. In the summer, I almost never use it, except maybe around my eyes before I applied an eye cream or for other spot treatment of dry areas. My skin gets super dry in the winter, and it becomes my DAILY serum for maybe a week every few weeks to bring back moisture to my face. More so like a treatment, if anything. (Literally nothing else I've tried only gives INSTANT moisture as deep as this. Nothing stops the peeling or itchy feeling on my face like this.) I will use a toner, apply this, then a hylauro

I am so happy that I finally decided to try this! It works amazingly! I have sensitive, dry, very acne prone skin. I can at anytime be dealing with redness and needing barrier repair. I accidently mixed a couple ingredients on my skin that I should not have and ended up burning a couple areas. This took those spots from red and stinging to calm, instantly sod and redness went way down within a day! The repairing happened that quick! This is now a staple in my routine. I think this is the best product Ordinary has. Oh and sidenote, I love the way it smells lol :) there's no fragrance added, of course— it's just the natural scent of it. :)

extraits.titre: Very good serum for dry sensitive skin
extraits.texte: Ive been uaing this for a few months now. I use it as my third serum on my non- strong product nights either on its own or mixed with squalane. Just one or two drops is enough. Seems to soothe the dry red patches on my chin. I use very strong products every other night as im over 40 so this is a great way to restrengthen my skin barrier so i can keep using the other strong products. I had to test this product for one week. One drop on the inside of my elbow twice a day for at least 5 days and then wait another 2 days for a reaction. If your good then start using on your jawline for a few days. My skin is not so sensitive but i use strong priducts and sometimes they dont work well together. I recommend you do this as well with every product.

extraits.titre: My problem skin LOVES this product!
extraits.texte: Based on the reviews it seems like your skin will either love or hate this. My skin loves it. I have difficult skin that is somehow dry, acne prone, oily, and sensitive all at once. It can be very hard to find products to fix one problem without making another worse. There seems to be a lot of recent hype about barrier support skincare, and this seemed like a good way to try it without spending a lot. I added this to my skincare routine morning and night without changing anything else and it has gotten rid of my flakiness, old acne spots, and new ones have not formed. And this is normally the time of month my skin is the worst (iykyk). In fact, I just recently switched to a lighter moisturizer for daytime since my skin is not so uncomfortable anymore and the oiliness has improved, too. I am so thrilled. And for the price it is worth a try!

I tried lessening my useage of it to only once a day, to then twice a week, but my face was incredibly oily, to the point where my skin became severely dried out (worsening the issue of dead skin I was trying to fix beforehand) and my pores got clogged from all the excess oil on my face. Caused a bad acne breakout on my chin that is still healing. I would not recommend for oily or acne prone sensitive skin.
